protocol.split: DEV only; all 50 invoice and 10 bank pages
protocol.rationale: Own hypotheses: asymmetric detector/recognizer capacity and full-width overlapping strip detection inspired by modular PP-OCRv6 and SAHI. Not exact reproductions of either paper. No thresholds fit to the reference labels.
protocol.selection_rule: Report all modes. Consider shipping only after Rust/WASM parity and fixed-input regressions; no automatic default replacement. Report token recall with precision and full-field exact counts. Native unpaired time is descriptive only.
protocol.suppression_priority: Full-page detections first, then larger distance from the strip boundary; axis-aligned intersection over smaller. No text labels used.

limits: DEV only; Python/native reference pipeline, not shipped Rust/browser. No complete-page hallucination score for partial invoice annotations; no speedup or SOTA claim.
